dedupe_keys.name: electricity smart meter data set of chinese households insights into prosumers

description: This data set gives anonymised household smart meter measurements from 15 low-voltage transformer areas in China, focused on prosumers with behind-the-meter generation. It was published on figshare by Zs Yan, Shuntao Xu, Xiang Guo, Jing Yang, Peng Liu and He Wen. It holds net active power for 2,162 households, 620 prosumers and 1,542 consumers, with prosumer labels, data quality summaries, matched hourly weather, field dictionaries and reproducibility code. Daily profiles use a unified 96-field layout organised by transformer area and month; hourly records fill only the hourly fields without interpolation, and positive values mean imports from the grid. Coverage is 15 anonymised transformer areas at 15-minute or hourly resolution. The files are downloadable from figshare (version 1, 2026) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: locations are anonymised, sampling modes are mixed, and the areas may not represent China as a whole. Simulation uses are low-voltage network operation, reverse power flow and PV estimation studies. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
